A command is accepted by the component that owns its context, emits the events one of its outcomes declares, and a dashed edge is a binding carrying an event into the next command. Design §9 begins one step earlier, at the actor who invokes the first command, and so does this graph: a solid edge out of an actor is a grant, and an actor drawn with no edge at all may invoke nothing — which is something the model says, not an arrow somebody forgot.

## Bounded contexts

- **[approval_issuers](./domains/connectors-approval_issuers.md)** (`connectors.approval_issuers`) — Local issuer identities and immutable signing-key versions with guarded publication. Two types, two entities, two views, seven commands, seven events, three errors and one actor.
- **[artifact_provenance](./domains/connectors-artifact_provenance.md)** (`connectors.artifact_provenance`) — Immutable shared source and bundle declarations; optional distribution publication is separate. Nine types, two entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[auth_access](./domains/connectors-auth_access.md)** (`connectors.auth_access`) — Proposed access selection, acquisition declaration and exact permission-budget values; no runtime or persistent owner. 15 types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[auth_bindings](./domains/connectors-auth_bindings.md)** (`connectors.auth_bindings`) — Proposed host-private auth records and acknowledged lifecycle boundaries. Eight types, four entities, seven views, 17 commands, 17 events, eight errors and one actor.
- **[cli](./domains/connectors-cli.md)** (`connectors.cli`) — Selected local CLI presentation values and the existing local configuration owner's durable runtime facts. 144 types, three entities, two views, seven commands, seven events, one error and one actor.
- **[clock](./domains/connectors-clock.md)** (`connectors.clock`) — Explicitly trusted local clock configuration, bounded observations and owner anti-regression floors. Eight types, one entity, one view, two commands, two events, one error and one actor.
- **[connection_admission](./domains/connectors-connection_admission.md)** (`connectors.connection_admission`) — Proposed connection viability, request eligibility and host management target values; no runtime checker or persistent connection lifecycle. 13 types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[credential_evidence](./domains/connectors-credential_evidence.md)** (`connectors.credential_evidence`) — Proposed generation-bound evidence values and transient dispatch admission decisions. Eight types, two entities, two views, eight commands, eight events, three errors and one actor.
- **[credentials](./domains/connectors-credentials.md)** (`connectors.credentials`) — Host-private immutable credential snapshot identities shared by refresh and evidence. Three types, one entity, one view, one command, one event, no errors and one actor.
- **[declarations](./domains/connectors-declarations.md)** (`connectors.declarations`) 13 types, five entities, one view, three commands, three events, three errors and two actors.
- **[delegation](./domains/connectors-delegation.md)** (`connectors.delegation`) — One-hop approval subjects and immutable receiver receipts; private host approval binding, no delegated ingress runtime. 22 types, two entities, one view, one command, one event, no errors and one actor.
- **[discovery](./domains/connectors-discovery.md)** (`connectors.discovery`) — Discovery scope, publication, fixed route and immutable composition values; persistent collection ownership is in discovery_state. 23 types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[discovery_state](./domains/connectors-discovery_state.md)** (`connectors.discovery_state`) — Host-owned scope epochs, bounded observation records and atomic publication selections; no provider Resource entity. Eight types, two entities, no views, 10 commands, six events, three errors and no actors.
- **[execution_audit](./domains/connectors-execution_audit.md)** (`connectors.execution_audit`) — Per-hop durable execution-audit anchor and one final observation; private host port, with dispatch integration and exporter pending. 13 types, one entity, one view, three commands, three events, eight errors and two actors.
- **[feed](./domains/connectors-feed.md)** (`connectors.feed`) — Proposed provider-independent incremental reads of a connection's containers and their items; no runtime or persistent provider owner. 22 types, two entities, four views, seven commands, five events, five errors and two actors.
- **[idempotency](./domains/connectors-idempotency.md)** (`connectors.idempotency`) — Proposed receiver-owned keyed mutation reservations and replay retention. Seven types, one entity, two views, four commands, four events, one error and one actor.
- **[local_approval_policy](./domains/connectors-local_approval_policy.md)** (`connectors.local_approval_policy`) — Proposed serialized local owner policy for approval issuance and write admission. Three types, one entity, one view, two commands, two events, five errors and one actor.
- **[mutations](./domains/connectors-mutations.md)** (`connectors.mutations`) — Host-owned mutation attempt ledger with a private local binding; not a public mutation API. 12 types, one entity, two views, six commands, six events, two errors and two actors.
- **[oauth2](./domains/connectors-oauth2.md)** (`connectors.oauth2`) — Provider-neutral OAuth 2.0 authorization servers a profile declares, and the access tokens the host issues to a local caller from a stored grant. Nine types, two entities, two views, two commands, two events, five errors and one actor.
- **[refresh](./domains/connectors-refresh.md)** (`connectors.refresh`) — Proposed host-owned durable authorization of one rotating refresh per credential generation. Nine types, one entity, one view, nine commands, nine events, four errors and no actors.
- **[service_wire](./domains/connectors-service_wire.md)** (`connectors.service_wire`) — Public service envelope, observation and operation metadata values; the first v1alpha2 binding is served and read, no persisted entity. 21 types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[sessions](./domains/connectors-sessions.md)** (`connectors.sessions`) — Proposed supervising session lifecycle; timed enforcement remains a binding obligation. 11 types, one entity, one view, eight commands, 10 events, one error and no actors.
- **[transport](./domains/connectors-transport.md)** (`connectors.transport`) — Bounded private transport values without credential or dispatch authority. Six types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[websearch](./domains/connectors-websearch.md)** (`connectors.websearch`) — Proposed provider-independent web search, fetch and crawl values; no runtime or persistent provider owner. 14 types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.

## Components

A component is a unit of ownership, not a deployment. How many of each runs, and what each needs, is [the topology](./topology.md).

**`feed-binding`** — Any adapter that binds datasource.feed/v1alpha1; a fixture binding realises it for conformance, its Provider commands seeding the source it reads. It owns [`connectors.feed`](./domains/connectors-feed.md). It accepts `connectors.feed.AddContainer`, `connectors.feed.AddItem`, `connectors.feed.ListContainers`, `connectors.feed.ReadItems`, `connectors.feed.RemoveItem`, `connectors.feed.RestoreItem` and `connectors.feed.ReviseItem`. It publishes `connectors.feed.ContainerAdded`, `connectors.feed.ItemAdded`, `connectors.feed.ItemRemoved`, `connectors.feed.ItemRestored` and `connectors.feed.ItemRevised`.

**`local-metadata-authority`** — Owns the local host decisions retained by the recorded metadata authority. It owns [`connectors.approval_issuers`](./domains/connectors-approval_issuers.md), [`connectors.auth_bindings`](./domains/connectors-auth_bindings.md), [`connectors.cli`](./domains/connectors-cli.md), [`connectors.clock`](./domains/connectors-clock.md), [`connectors.credential_evidence`](./domains/connectors-credential_evidence.md), [`connectors.credentials`](./domains/connectors-credentials.md), [`connectors.declarations`](./domains/connectors-declarations.md), [`connectors.delegation`](./domains/connectors-delegation.md), [`connectors.execution_audit`](./domains/connectors-execution_audit.md), [`connectors.idempotency`](./domains/connectors-idempotency.md), [`connectors.local_approval_policy`](./domains/connectors-local_approval_policy.md), [`connectors.mutations`](./domains/connectors-mutations.md), [`connectors.oauth2`](./domains/connectors-oauth2.md) and [`connectors.refresh`](./domains/connectors-refresh.md). It accepts `connectors.approval_issuers.AdvanceIssuerRevision`, `connectors.approval_issuers.BindIssuer`, `connectors.approval_issuers.ConfirmKeyDeletion`, `connectors.approval_issuers.PublishKey`,
